configured_dispatch.claim_basis: frozen dispatch runtime, exact assignment goals/policies/journals, coordinator invocation/direct-call records and actual host completion; not missing logs alone

task_scope: Repair seeded pre-action observation alignment and accepted-only export faults, then rerun real MuJoCo and native LeRobot acceptance.
policy: Configured workspace dispatch; GLM-5.3-Flash primary and GLM-5.3 fallback; verify failures hand off under the configured policy; Astra is available for unresolved attention.
comparison: Original faults, native workloads, prompt, workspace grants and independent acceptance remain unchanged. Pair7 runs specialists first; pair8-confirmation reverses the order.
zero_astra_basis: Positive binding of frozen dispatch, exact assignment goals and policies, durable worker journals, empty coordinator invocation and direct-call records, and verified host completion; not absent log files alone.
audit_method: Read-only inspection of all sealed edit/native/verification attempts, original fault bytes, actual model authorship, current source hashes and independent native receipts. No model calls, native reruns or grader reruns performed by this audit.
prior_results: Earlier six-arm, screening and selected-model confirmation exports remain unchanged and separate.
limitations: Task decomposition and required operations were configured by the operator; this does not demonstrate zero-Astra open-ended planning.
Small matched trials on two seeded repairs do not establish a general model ranking.
The controller is scripted MuJoCo control, not learned-policy training or physical robot transfer.
Finite native checks establish the stated contract, not arbitrary semantic correctness.
Timing includes execution and shutdown; shared-host load and per-request cost accounting are retained separately.

preparation_refusal.reason: A required prior-selection evidence file was missing before freeze.
preparation_refusal.handling: Original preparation preserved; fresh confirmation directories used after evidence became available.
